single.summary: Which number is prime? Pick one, checked at once, with feedback on the pick.

options.why: No prime up to $\sqrt{23}$ divides it.

solutions.text: Only $23$ has no divisor other than $1$ and itself.

multiple.summary: Tick every even function: several answers are right.

driving-theory.summary: A driving theory question: a red X over the lane; the reader picks the first option and is told why it is wrong.

props.label: Theory test
props.question: You are on a motorway and see a red X above your lane. What should you do?

hints.text: Red means a hard rule, not advice.

options.text: Slow down and stay in the lane
options.why: A red X closes the lane: you must not drive in it.

options.text: Move to a lane without a red X
options.why: The lane is closed ahead, often for a breakdown or workers.
Only when a sign over it shows a speed limit.

security-review.summary: A security review: tick what belongs in a pull request that adds a login form, then check and read why one does not belong.

props.label: Review
props.question: Which of these belong in a pull request that adds a login form?

options.text: A CSRF token on the form
options.why: Without one, another site can post the form for a logged-in user.

options.text: Logging the submitted password for debugging
options.why: Never: logs are read by many people and kept for a long time.

options.text: Serving the page over HTTPS only
options.why: Otherwise the password crosses the network in clear text.
